acyclic_derivation_order.rule: each object may reference only an item at the same or earlier completed stage when the referenced object is already immutable; any earlier object containing a later-stage hash, any mutual-hash pair, or any attempt to write runtime actual evidence into a presealed policy is DEPENDENCY_CYCLE_ERROR

authoritative_run_selection.original_compatible_predicate: Tri-state over every complete-corpus CLOUD_RUN that claimed original protocol before output and is not already known amended: all required identity/scope fields present and equal => COMPATIBLE; no known mismatch but one or more required fields missing => BLOCKED_COMPATIBLE; any known mismatch => AMENDED. COMPATIBLE and BLOCKED_COMPATIBLE are both graph nodes and legacy candidates, so missing identity cannot make a claimed-original run disappear; BLOCKED_COMPATIBLE can never yield original PASS or authoritative status.
receipt_binds: fixed logical and physical aggregation rules
authoritative_run_selection.logical_and_physical_run_rule: A series slot names one logical run and an exact predeclared physical-attempt set. Within a logical run the only rule is ALL_PHYSICAL_ATTEMPTS_MUST_PASS; across logical runs the fixed rule is FAIL_DOMINANT_ALL_VALID_LOGICAL_RUNS. Missing/extra attempts or slots, best-of selection, outcome-conditioned stopping, or changing either rule is ERROR.
authoritative_run_selection.supersedes_graph: Every claimed-original non-amended node classified COMPATIBLE or BLOCKED_COMPATIBLE and every valid supersedes edge must form one connected append-only acyclic directed chain/DAG with exactly one active tip. Missing identity remains a BLOCKED_COMPATIBLE/BLOCKED_SERIES_IDENTITY node. Every edge is pre-output for its successor, points to an existing predecessor, and each predecessor has at most one valid direct successor. A new authoritative candidate must name the unique prior active tip as supersedes, or null only when the complete corpus proves no prior claimed-original non-amended node. The edge reason/receipt must satisfy original_run_series_contract; supersession never by itself removes a predecessor from the series reducer. Any disconnected node/tip, fork, missing predecessor, cycle, multiple tip or unregistered slot is ERROR; none may be auto-demoted to ARCHIVAL_ONLY.
authoritative_run_selection.exactly_one_valid_candidate: AUTHORITATIVE_ORIGINAL and the unique selected sink
authoritative_run_selection.post_output_designation_or_best-of-repea: ERROR; every prior valid scientific outcome remains consumed
authoritative_run_selection.legacy_candidate_definition: a COMPATIBLE or BLOCKED_COMPATIBLE historical CLOUD_RUN discovered from the complete corpus, not validly superseded, not amended, and not already authoritative
authoritative_run_selection.archival_only_derivation: Only an authenticated object that never claimed original protocol and is outside the original-compatible predicate may be ARCHIVAL_ONLY. It is never reporter-selected and cannot be used to hide a claimed-original, non-amended, disconnected, failing, or ambiguous run.
authoritative_run_selection.superseded_and_archival_failures: AMENDED/ARCHIVAL_ONLY and independently proven pre-outcome INVALIDATED_TECHNICAL runs remain preserved but are outside the current original reducer; every other superseded claimed-original run remains inside it

w1_reducers.W1_ORIGINAL_PROTOCOL: original_run_series_contract.series_reducer over every valid or series-identity-blocked claimed-original member, with FAIL/mandatory-PARTIAL dominance; PASS additionally requires the unique selected active tip be AUTHORITATIVE_ORIGINAL and PASS. A later green successor can never erase an earlier valid FAIL.
w1_reducers.W1_AMENDED_PROTOCOL: FAIL > BLOCKED > UNVERIFIED > PASS over separately designated amended runs, or NOT_RUN when none
w1_reducers.W1_INCLUSIVE: FAIL > BLOCKED > UNVERIFIED > PASS over current global, current candidate, and the series-reduced W1_ORIGINAL_PROTOCOL including all series participants; PASS additionally requires every plan section 14.2 conjunct, exact authoritative active tip, all required matrix results, G1-G7 evidence, Day2 all-three-trait completion, at least one valid anchor expression PASS, mutation/flake/seal/identity/known-defect gates
w1_reducers.MERGE_ELIGIBLE: independent reducer over only blocks_merge-resolved assertions plus candidate defect, seal, identity, and commit-safety gates; historical domain failure never becomes W1 PASS but need not block a fully verified defensive code merge
